profile.headline: Lead Software Engineer  | Scaling Cloud Infrastructure & Mentoring Engineering Teams

positions.title: Engineering Manager & Lead DevOps Engineer
positions.description:
Lead and manage a team of 4 engineering managers and QA specialists, overseeing technical delivery across multiple client projects

Spearheaded successful rollout of enterprise logistics platform to 6 manufacturing plants nationwide, ensuring seamless implementation and adoption.

Led the migration from Heroku to AWS Kubernetes (EKS), enabling efficient deployment and scaling of applications with custom Helm charts, increasing system reliability and reducing operational overhead.

Designed and implemented Terraform configurations to provision AWS infrastructure, including EKS clusters, VPC networking, IAM roles, and RDS databases.

Developed custom Helm charts to standardize deployments across applications.

Partner directly with company owner to develop and execute technical strategy aligned with business objectives and growth targets

Established comprehensive mentorship program for engineering managers, focusing on leadership development, technical excellence, and team building

positions.title: Lead DevOps Engineer & Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
Lead remote engineering teams, located in the US and across the globe

Recruit, interview, and on-board employees and independent contractors

Transitioned applications to containerized deployments, introducing Docker while continuing to host on Heroku.

Updated CI/CD pipelines in CircleCI to support containerized applications, optimizing build times and deployment efficiency.

Work with leadership to align engineering objectives and key results with organizational goals
Mentor, coach, and train engineers for continued growth

positions.title: Senior DevOps Engineer & Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Provide architectural guidance for full-stack, web-based solutions and features

Reviewed code via pull requests and pair programming for quality, performance, and consistency

Created and enforced development standards for modern web, REST APIs, and GraphQL APIs

Led the migration from manual Heroku deployments to a streamlined CI/CD pipeline using CircleCI, integrating with Heroku for continuous deployment and automated testing.

Began containerizing applications and refining deployment strategies, while still leveraging Heroku as the hosting platform.

Collaborated effectively with other engineers, product stakeholders, and designers

Prioritized client deliverables based on evolving schedules across globally distributed teams

positions.title: DevOps Engineer & Full-Stack Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed performant, responsive web apps and the REST APIs that power them

Lead client collaboration to align technical requirements and architecture with product goals

Configured and maintained GitHub-Heroku integration for continuous deployment ensuring seamless API deployment with minimal manual intervention.

Responsible for configuring and managing all hosting and deployment processes using Heroku as the primary platform.

Ensured applications ran efficiently on Heroku, focusing on uptime, scaling, and resolving any deployment-related issues.

Stack: Ruby on Rails, REST API, GraphQL and React, Angular JS. Angular 2

positions.title: Contractor I.T. Help Desk
positions.description:
Managed the system for software deployment.

Diagnose, troubleshoot and resolve a range of software, hardware     and connectivity issues. 

Assist with the configuration of new and reformatted pcs.

positions.title: I.T. Specialist
positions.description:
	Setup a program to expedite the configuration process for new PCs.

	Assist with organization of The High School Technology Club.

	Diagnose, troubleshoot and resolve a range of software, hardware and connectivity issues. 

	In charge of research for hardware and software upgrades and solutions.
